rules.text: A $7 fee is applied to online returns.
rules.quote: A $7 fee will be applied to your return.

rules.text: You receive an email confirmation when your online return package is received.
rules.quote: Look for the return label in your package, then drop it off at the post office, and you’ll receive an email confirmation of your receipt.
rules.reviewNote: The quote says you receive an email confirmation of your receipt, but it is unclear if this refers to the package being received by Hollister or just the return label being processed. The summary assumes it is when the return package is received, which is not explicitly stated in the quote.
